description: Independent historical event cohorts for retail competing exits; all fits precede the 2024 application/transition examples.

RETAIL_RESIDENTIAL_MORTGAGE.interpretation: Time unit days; separate observed cohorts for competing-risk, grouped and time-to-exit estimands. monthly mortgage instalment; capital remains after temporary relief

RETAIL_HOME_EQUITY_LINE.interpretation: Time unit days; separate observed cohorts for competing-risk, grouped and time-to-exit estimands. interest-only line; undrawn commitment is not past-due principal

RETAIL_UNSECURED_INSTALLMENT.interpretation: Time unit days; separate observed cohorts for competing-risk, grouped and time-to-exit estimands. fixed instalment; reduced first payment is recovered in period three

RETAIL_EDUCATION_LOAN.interpretation: Time unit days; separate observed cohorts for competing-risk, grouped and time-to-exit estimands. first contractual payment after documented grace, not during grace

RETAIL_AUTO_LOAN.interpretation: Time unit days; separate observed cohorts for competing-risk, grouped and time-to-exit estimands. unpaid balloon; prospective extension preserves principal and accrued interest

RETAIL_AUTO_LEASE.interpretation: Time unit days; separate observed cohorts for competing-risk, grouped and time-to-exit estimands. finance-lease monetary claim; returned asset residual value is separate

RETAIL_CREDIT_CARD.interpretation: Time unit days; separate observed cohorts for competing-risk, grouped and time-to-exit estimands. minimum due is 50, not full statement balance; revolving principal remains

RETAIL_CHARGE_CARD.interpretation: Time unit days; separate observed cohorts for competing-risk, grouped and time-to-exit estimands. full statement due; instalment conversion is a proposal only

RETAIL_OVERDRAFT.interpretation: Time unit days; separate observed cohorts for competing-risk, grouped and time-to-exit estimands. explicit demand for excess over authorized 1000; authorized balance is not demanded

RETAIL_BNPL.interpretation: Time unit days; separate observed cohorts for competing-risk, grouped and time-to-exit estimands. four-payment plan; missed first instalment plus second due, no annualized good label

RETAIL_MICRO_LOAN.interpretation: Time unit days; separate observed cohorts for competing-risk, grouped and time-to-exit estimands. weekly collection with seasonal capacity; later catch-up can remain unaffordable

RETAIL_SMALL_BUSINESS_FINANCE.interpretation: Time unit days; separate observed cohorts for competing-risk, grouped and time-to-exit estimands. working-capital principal; owner transfer is not additional operating income
